scope: Exploratory candidate in a separate copied game/package. One sequential control and candidate run; not accepted optimization evidence. Original package unchanged.

control.scope: Whole World.recalcPlayer with final allocations from 39 class policy traces and one rare Lapis Ring; 117 rebuilds per sample. Includes item compilation and unchanged host rebuild work; excludes rendering, initial content compilation and fixture setup.
limits: Desktop only; no Steam Deck or older mobile measurements.
Total allocation and retained heap are not measured.
This is a cumulative game-adapter comparison; it does not isolate passive-grant CPU cost.
